frontmatter.description: Audits trainee capstone code (repo, PR or local folder) against the Definition of Done — runs lint/build/test, codegen diff, secret and image scans, IaC and IAM checks — and records evidence in the AiMentor portal.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: Scan Lan's repo and tell me which DoD items are still failing.
frontmatter.assistant: I'll use the dod-auditor agent to run the DoD checks on that repo.

frontmatter.name: exam-grader
frontmatter.description: Scans the Google Drive AiMentor/Exams folders for trainee submissions, grades them against the module rubric, writes scores and feedback to the AiMentor portal, and flags borderline or suspicious cases for a human.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: Grade the Module 2 exams that came in today.
frontmatter.assistant: I'll run the exam-grader agent to pull the M2 submissions from Drive and grade them.

frontmatter.name: tutor-async-events
frontmatter.description: Module 3 tutor (Async & Event-Driven): AWS SNS, SQS, SQS DLQ, EventBridge, EventBridge Scheduler, idempotent consumers. Use for trainee questions and lab help on Days 9–10.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: My consumer processes the same OrderPlaced message twice, how do I stop that?
frontmatter.assistant: This is an idempotency question — I'll hand it to the Module 3 tutor agent.

frontmatter.name: tutor-contract-api
frontmatter.description: Module 1 tutor (Contract & Core API): Go basics, OpenAPI 3.0, JSON Schema, oapi-codegen v2, Gin middleware and error handling, GitHub Copilot usage. Use for any trainee question or lab help on Days 1–5.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: My oapi-codegen strict server doesn't compile with Gin, what am I missing?
frontmatter.assistant: Let me bring in the Module 1 tutor agent to walk you through the strict-server wiring.

frontmatter.name: tutor-data-encryption
frontmatter.description: Module 2 tutor (Data & Encryption): AWS SDK for Go v2, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, AWS KMS envelope encryption of PII. Use for trainee questions and lab help on Days 6–8.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: How do I encrypt the customer email before saving to DynamoDB?
frontmatter.assistant: I'll use the Module 2 tutor agent to explain KMS envelope encryption for that field.

frontmatter.name: tutor-gateway-security
frontmatter.description: Module 4 tutor (Gateway, Network & Security): Kong, AWS Cognito, least-privilege IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, AppConfig, VPC/subnets/security groups, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, Megaport, Route 53, CloudTrail, Apigee Edge migration. Use for Days 11–12.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: Should my DB password go in Parameter Store or Secrets Manager?
frontmatter.assistant: I'll use the Module 4 tutor agent to explain the scope rules for each store.

frontmatter.name: tutor-quality-ops
frontmatter.description: Module 6 tutor (Quality, Observability & Ops): go lint/build/test, coverage, Datadog APM/Logs/RUM/Metrics, CloudWatch, PagerDuty, Jira, Confluence, Atlassian Rovo. Use any day for lint/test help and on Day 15 for observability.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: How do I get the same trace ID from the API into my SQS consumer logs in Datadog?
frontmatter.assistant: I'll use the Module 6 tutor agent to trace the correlation ID across the queue.

frontmatter.name: tutor-runtime-cicd
frontmatter.description: Module 5 tutor (Runtime, IaC & CI/CD): Docker, AWS ECS, AWS Lambda, AWS CloudFormation, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Buildkite. Use for Days 13–14.
frontmatter.Context: A bootcamp trainee or mentor is working on the AiMentor program
frontmatter.user: My Docker image has 12 high vulnerabilities, how do I get to zero?
frontmatter.assistant: I'll pull in the Module 5 tutor agent to fix the image build.
